title: Boom Box
description: With this data pack, you can equip Sulfur Cubes with TNT blocks. These explosive companions will detonate immediately upon impacting the ground.

# 📖 Description
Boom Box transforms the new Sulfur Cubes into the ultimate tactical explosive. This data pack allows you to store TNT blocks inside these creatures, turning them into living projectiles. When a Sulfur Cube falls from a height of 8 blocks or more, the kinetic energy triggers a devastating reaction upon impact. Because the cube is composed of highly reactive sulfur, the chemical mixture with the TNT creates an amplified blast, resulting in an explosion much more powerful and larger than that of a standard TNT block.
